description: This file contains a collection of Sass mixins related to gradient backgrounds, including linear gradients in various directions, multi-color gradients, radial gradients, and stripe patterns, used for styling gradient backgrounds in CSS.

methods.name: gradient-bg
methods.description: Applies a background color and optionally a gradient background if $enable-gradients is true.

methods.name: gradient-x
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient from left to right with specified start and end colors and positions.

methods.name: gradient-y
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient from top to bottom with specified start and end colors and optional positions.

methods.name: gradient-directional
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient at a specified degree with start and end colors.

methods.name: gradient-x-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal three-color linear gradient with specified start, middle, and end colors.

methods.name: gradient-y-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical three-color linear gradient with specified start, middle, and end colors.

methods.name: gradient-radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with inner and outer colors.

methods.name: gradient-striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern using linear-gradient at a specified angle with transparent and semi-transparent white stripes.
